title: Race to Alaska
subtitle: 3rd place
text: In 2019 I raced the 750-mile Race to Alaska with Team Shut Up and Drive, a crew of eight on a Beneteau Figaro 2. We sailed when the wind allowed and pedaled when it didn't, and finished third.

title: MIT Green Building Challenge
subtitle: Record holder: 48 runs
text: The [Green Building Challenge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_Building_%28MIT%29#Green_Building_Challenge) is a tradition of MIT's [Bad Ideas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traditions_and_student_activities_at_MIT#Bad_Ideas_Festival) weekend: teams try to climb the stairs of the 18-story Green Building as many times as they can in an evening. In September 2007, I climbed them 48 times, a new record.
